verdict.rationale: Motion's meeting-assistant page says video conferencing links are automatically added to every meeting with zero setup, and Motion offers embeddable booking pages with per-scenario meeting templates. That covers the core of the story: each booking gets a link automatically. missing for 10: documentation of which providers are supported for auto-added links (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams), any evidence of native video, per-template provider configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
